description: This file implements in-memory buffering for transaction read and write operations in the etcd storage backend, including buffer management, deduplication, and merging of key-value pairs.

classes.name: txBuffer
classes.description: Handles shared functionality for transaction buffers, managing buckets of key-value pairs.

classes.name: txWriteBuffer
classes.description: Buffers pending write updates, ensuring monotonic key order where applicable.

classes.name: txReadBuffer
classes.description: Provides buffered read access to transaction data, supporting range queries and iteration.

classes.name: bucketBuffer
classes.description: Buffers key-value pairs pending commit, with methods for range queries, merging, and deduplication.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the transaction buffer, clearing used entries.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Buffers a key-value pair for a specific bucket, marking the bucket as non-sequential.

methods.name: putSeq
methods.description: Buffers a key-value pair with monotonic increasing key validation.

methods.name: putInternal
methods.description: Internal method to add key-value pairs to a bucket buffer.

methods.name: writeback
methods.description: Merges buffered write data into a read buffer, handling deduplication and sorting.

methods.name: Range
methods.description: Retrieves key-value pairs within a specified key range from a bucket buffer.

methods.name: ForEach
methods.description: Iterates over all key-value pairs in a bucket buffer, applying a visitor function.

methods.name: unsafeCopy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the read buffer for concurrent access.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the bucket buffer.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another bucket buffer into this one, maintaining order.

methods.name: dedupe
methods.description: Removes duplicate keys, keeping only the newest update.

methods.name: CopyUsed
methods.description: Creates a copy of the bucket buffer containing only used entries.
